title: 202. Femme

title: 201. Première Ligne
dressCode: Young men shirtless with lots of tattoos, only in short swim shorts (red, black, white, light blue, grey) with the waistband of designer boxers showing; sunglasses, short faded haircuts, gym-built bodies.

title: 200. Sad Ambient Boys
dressCode: Young men dressed almost entirely in black or very dark navy: plain or subtly printed dark knit sweaters and long-sleeve tops, dark trousers, occasionally grey jeans; messy mid-length or curtain hair, pale and understated, no bright colour anywhere. The dark top is essential, dark trousers alone are not enough.

title: 199. Team Total 90
dressCode: Young people mixing football (soccer) jerseys and track jackets with streetwear: retro or club shirts, training tops, shiny sports fabrics, worn with dark trousers or shorts; short cropped hair, some piercings.

title: 197. Architects

title: 196. Comrades

title: 194. Fitgirls

title: 193. Sportlimas

title: 192. Ummah United

title: 191. Hudabeauties

title: 190. Balenciaga by Demna

title: 189. Balenciaga by Demna
dressCode: Runway streetwear pushed to extremes: oversized hoodies, logo tees and sweats, huge puffer or bomber jackets, washed denim jackets, caps and hoods, sometimes face-covering; baggy and deliberately odd.

title: 188. Balenciaga by Demna
dressCode: Runway looks in body-hugging stretch pieces: skin-tight zip tops and catsuits, bodycon mini dresses, lace or ruched details, fluffy boa, tight leggings, small bags, dark sunglasses; sleek and futuristic.

title: 187. Messies
dressCode: Young people in oversized bomber or puffer jackets (olive, grey, navy, black) zipped up, with a hood, beanie or scarf around the head, and a short plaid, camo or ruffled skirt or shorts peeking out underneath; messy, layered, thrown-together.

title: 186. Nada Saves
dressCode: Creative, eclectic people in loud one-off pieces: DIY or painted garments, graphic sweaters with big text, patterned mesh tops, printed or patchwork jackets, bright colours and clashing prints; dyed hair, mixed ages.

title: 185. They
dressCode: Queer, gender-fluid young people in playful mixed pieces: cropped tanks and camis, mesh or crochet tops, mini skirts and kilts, low-rise trousers, layered necklaces; short or bleached hair, visible skin.

title: 184. Shine

title: 183. Ukraine House

title: 182. Polski Streetshop

title: 181. Kotomisi

title: 179. Velha Guarda

title: 178. Chi
